qwen38-flash-next-cuda-vram128-vllm-mia-.description: MiaAI Qwen3.8 Flash-Next NVFP4 vLLM profile for one 128GB DGX Spark/GB10: 64k context, 8 concurrent sequences, MTP=3, FP8 KV, mmap PLE CPU offload, image/video input, 26 GiB host reserve, and active-model alias. Self-contained compose downloads the pinned MiaAI Git recipe and applies patches inside the container. GPU startup, health/model APIs, and 8 short concurrent chats validated on hipatia and pitia on 2026-09-05; full-context load, sustained throughput, FP8 quality, and multimodal input remain untested.
